description: Shared behavioral contract for the weighted upload queue that exists twice by design: src/lib/upload-queue.ts (web) and ugc-mobile/lib/upload-file.ts (mobile). The two workspaces cannot share code, so each side's test suite replays these scenarios against its own implementation — a semantic change that lands on only one side fails the other side's CI.

scenarios.name: two images run concurrently and the third waits for a freed slot
a video consumes both slots and never runs beside another item
a failure frees its slot, later items still run, and successes are kept
